settings.binding: Shell configuration binds Foundation:Web to FoundationWebDefaultsOptions; native owner validation admits the resulting values.
settings.description: Supported SupportedLocales value owned by FoundationWebDefaultsOptions.

semanticConstraints: An explicit SupportedLocales selection clears initialized array before binding; empty/null/non-indexed values reject rather than restoring fallback.
SupportedLocales must contain DefaultLocale ignoring case and distinct nonempty CultureInfo-recognized locale names.

semanticConstraints: Policies and feature selectors bind as native string-key dictionaries over initialized source values.
DefaultPolicy and every feature/endpoint selector must resolve an existing complete policy; headers are selected as a whole and not merged across policies.
Named policy keys must be nonempty ASCII letters/digits/dot/hyphen/underscore and at most128 characters.

settings.description: Supported AllowIndexing value owned by WebResponsePolicyOptions.

semanticConstraints: Headers must contain printable ASCII with no control characters. CSP requires default-src, frame-ancestors none, object-src none and base-uri self/none; unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval are prohibited.
Permissions-Policy grammar and distinct directive identities are enforced by WebResponsePolicyCatalog.
PublicAssetMaxAgeSeconds zero means no-store; caching/indexing remains endpoint/application policy.
